name: Ibrahim Nameh
bio: Ibrahim is a Project Manager and Cloud Data Architect with extensive experience designing end-to-end data solutions. At Alphabyte, he serves as IT Director overseeing cloud data strategy and architecture, web application development, and account management for the company's largest clients.

His career spans enterprise-scale delivery at PepsiCo, where he led BI and Trade Promotions Management solutions, through to hands-on development of web applications and data pipelines at Alphabyte. He brings deep expertise in Azure, SQL Server, Python, and modern BI tooling.
